$comment: Drift guard for the vendored Osprey.ML sources. MARS.Test hashes every file listed
here and fails when one no longer matches, which turns an accidental local edit into
a visible test failure rather than a silent fork. Run scripts/sync-osprey-ml.ps1
against a pwiz checkout to pull upstream changes and rewrite these hashes.
Osprey.ML remains the owner of this code. Fix bugs upstream in pwiz, then re-sync.
commitSubject: Addressed code review feedback on PR #4595

files.note: Fragment extracted from a file that also pulls in MathNet.Numerics and Osprey.Core. Guarded semantically by a golden output sequence in MARS.Test, not by an upstream file hash.
